metadata.title: JalRakshak 2.0 GIS Regional Boundaries: Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and Control Lines
metadata.source: Natural Earth Vector (v5.1.1, 10m & 50m Cultural Vectors) & UN Cartography Standards
metadata.reorganisation: Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 (Separate UT of Jammu & Kashmir and UT of Ladakh)
metadata.disputed_territory_policy: Disputed/occupied territories delineated separately and excluded from ordinary administrative polygon fills. Control lines (LoC, LAC) rendered with distinct dashed cartographic treatment.

properties.name: Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir
Pakistan-administered Kashmir (Azad Kashmir & Gilgit-Baltistan)
properties.status: De facto administered by Pakistan; claimed by India
properties.disclaimer: Excluded from ordinary Indian administrative territory

properties.name: China-administered Aksai Chin
properties.status: De facto administered by China; claimed by India
properties.disclaimer: Excluded from ordinary Indian administrative territory

properties.name: Trans-Karakoram Tract (Shaksgam Valley)
properties.status: Administered by China (ceded by Pakistan 1963); claimed by India
properties.disclaimer: Excluded from ordinary Indian administrative territory

properties.name: Siachen Glacier / Saltoro Ridge Zone
properties.status: Indian military control along AGPL; disputed demarcation
properties.disclaimer: Demarcated by Actual Ground Position Line (AGPL)

properties.name: Line of Control (LoC)
properties.description: Military control line between India and Pakistan in Jammu & Kashmir

properties.name: Line of Actual Control (LAC)
properties.description: Effective demarcation line between Indian-administered Ladakh and Chinese-controlled Aksai Chin

properties.name: 1963 Sino-Pakistan Alignment (Shaksgam Boundary)
properties.description: Provisional border line claimed by India as illegal cession
